description: Skredhendelser is a dataset listed in National Data Catalog of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Statens vegvesen. Road related avalance and landslide information. Coverage: Statens vegvesen. The portal shows the English title as "Road related avalance and landslide information" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Statens vegvesen. Its keywords include veg. The listing shows 2 download or service links in JSON, XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.norge.no/nlod/no). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-norge-no.
